d: A Kenyan court has convicted cult leader Paul Nthenge Mackenzie and around 30 others of murder in one of the country’s deadliest cult-related tragedies. Mackenzie allegedly convinced followers to starve themselves to meet Jesus, with children made to go without food first. More than 400 bodies have been recovered from a remote forest, and many families are still waiting for answers. Why did authorities fail to stop the cult before the tragedy unfolded? Palki Sharma tells you.
